the host's own UIKit under Mac Catalyst through tests/backports/host/popover, and tests/backports/device/popover.m with real touches on the iPad 2 and the iPhone 4S; the port's own object is packages/frameworks/apple-backports/UIKit/UIPresentationController.m, and the property is the SUPERCLASS's: UIPresentationController.h:76 declares delegate for every presentation controller and UIPopoverPresentationController.h:42 redeclares it with the popover's own protocol, and UIPopoverPresentationController.m:25 is @dynamic, so the pair is UIPresentationController's own -delegate/-setDelegate: over its __weak _delegate, which the port carries because the release has no UIPresentationController before iOS 8. Measured on the port's own class under a prefixed name: instancesRespondToSelector: is 1 for both, and neither is among its own 26 instance methods; the superclass chain answers both
